caveat: This verifier signs in with a dedicated synthetic test user and exercises user-owned rows/RPCs. It proves the redacted artifact save/delete and saved-analysis deletion receipt path for that test user only; it does not prove malware scanning, PDF/DOCX extraction, provider-log deletion, backups, legal compliance, employment-selection validity, or buyer-specific governance.
manualInterventionIfSkipped: Create a dedicated Supabase Auth test user that contains no real resume or client data.
Add LIVE_SUPABASE_TEST_USER_EMAIL and LIVE_SUPABASE_TEST_USER_PASSWORD as local env values or GitHub Actions secrets.
Rotate the test password if it is ever pasted into chat, logs, or tracked files.
